summary: Wetouch Technology Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into share purchase agreements with controlling shareholders Qixun Technology Limited and Qihong Technology Limited, who will purchase 31,037,830 newly issued common shares at $1.25 per share for gross proceeds of $38.8 million. The private placement is priced at a premium to market under Nasdaq rules and expected to close on or about August 4, 2026. Shares are subject to a one-year lock-up. Proceeds will fund in-house development or acquisition of touch-screen complete systems. This is an unregistered sale under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D to accredited investors, effectively a capital raise from existing insiders. Watch for closing conditions and use of proceeds execution.
